verdict.rationale: The evidence shows mParticle documents several HTTP APIs (Warehouse Sync API, Platform Audiences API, event APIs), but nothing indicates a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI, Swagger, or Postman. Human-readable API docs are adjacent to this story and do not satisfy it, so with no evidence of a spec the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
